title: Velvety German Pork Skewers
description: A quick-fix German dish featuring pickles and sous-vide cooked pork, perfect for a weeknight dinner, this recipe is gluten-free friendly and offers a cultured and silky texture.
instructions: Preheat the sous-vide machine to 130 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a bowl, whisk together olive oil, salt, black pepper, and paprika.
Add the pork pieces to the bowl and toss to coat with the marinade.
Thread the marinated pork pieces onto skewers, leaving a small space between each piece.
Place the skewers in the sous-vide machine and cook for 2 hours.
While the pork is cooking, prepare the pickle mixture by combining chopped pickles, onion, and garlic in a bowl.
Once the pork is cooked, remove it from the sous-vide machine and brush with the pickle mixture.
Serve the pork skewers hot, garnished with additional chopped pickles if desired.
